theorem sum_residueMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) {q delta : ℕ}
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hdq : delta ∣ q) :
    (∑ b ∈ reducedResidues delta, residueMass N beta q delta b) =

private theorem pair_indicator {q r n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (z₁ z₂ : ℂ) :
    (∑ b ∈ reducedResidues (q.gcd r),
      (if n₁.Coprime q ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) n₁ b then z₁ else 0) *
        star (if n₂.Coprime r ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) n₂ b then z₂ else 0)) =
      if ComplexCRT.Compatible q r n₁ n₂ then z₁ * star z₂ else 0

theorem covariance_identity (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → ℂ) {q r : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    compatibleMass N beta q r -
      coprimeMass N beta q * star (coprimeMass N beta r) / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℂ) =
        covariance N beta q r

theorem actual_covariance_SW_bound {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom)
    (B C0 : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hadmissible : ∀ i, MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 (F i))
    (hSW : UniformAuxiliarySW F C0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
      ∀ i, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ q r : ℕ, 0 < q →
        ‖covariance (F i).alphaCarrier (F i).alpha q r‖ ≤
          C * (F i).U ^ 2 * (fouvryTau (2 ^ C0) (q / q.gcd r) : ℝ) /
            Real.log (F i).scale ^ A

all_five_reviewed_primitive_definitions.source_block:
def covariance (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → ℂ) (q r : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ b ∈ reducedResidues (q.gcd r),
    (residueMass N beta q (q.gcd r) b - coprimeMass N beta q / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℂ)) *
      star (residueMass N beta r (q.gcd r) b -
        coprimeMass N beta r / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℂ))

semantic_review.finding: The generic additive residue partition keeps the exact coprime sieve q. On positive q, gcd(q,r)>0 even when r=0. The complex compatibility sum partitions into residueMass(q,b)*star(residueMass(r,b)); centering uses exact sums of residue masses and the cardinal phi(gcd). Thus covariance_identity subtracts Cq*star(Cr)/phi(gcd), with no missing conjugation or extraneous phi factor.

Positive q,r supply nonzero totients/lcm. The exact gcd*lcm=q*r and totient_gcd_mul_totient_mul identities give the displayed complex denominator. This is finite arithmetic, not an identification with literal smoothed U or V.

semantic_review.finding: For positive delta dividing q, residue-class norm masses sum to at most original L1; the constant mean contributes at most the same L1 after cardinal phi(delta) cancels its nonzero denominator. Therefore sum of centered norms<=2L1 and norm covariance<=2*E*L1 from only the q-side AP bound. Norm-star removes conjugation without splitting real components.

For delta|q and b coprime delta, AP delta n b forces n coprime delta. Therefore coprimality to q equals coprimality to q/delta on that class. The mean sieve in original auxSWError is (q/delta)*delta=q. The proof keeps original alphaCarrier, complex alpha and signed original atom fields. This algebraic statement does not need q or delta positive; later SW application supplies positivity.
